## ICreateVerifiableCredentialArgs interface

Encapsulates the parameters required to create a [W3C Verifiable Credential](https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model/#credentials)

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ICreateVerifiableCredentialArgs extends UsingResolutionOptions
```

**Extends:** [UsingResolutionOptions](./core-types.usingresolutionoptions.md)
